parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: ServerGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the server groups.

parameters.name: ServerGroupNames
parameters.description: The names of the server groups. You can specify up to 10 names.

parameters.name: ServerGroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

- **Instance**: server type, which includes ECS, ENI, and ECI instances.

- **Ip**: IP address type.

- **Fc**: Function Compute type.

- If you leave this parameter empty, all types of server groups are queried.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are bound to the server group. You can specify up to 10 tags in a single request.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC-connected instance.
